description: A tall dark cup sits on the table in front, with a capped bottle of brown liquid to the right. The left hand steadies and then tilts the cup slightly toward the right while the right hand reaches in to grasp the bottle, lifts and angles its mouth over the cup as if to pour, then pulls the bottle back upright and returns it near its original spot; throughout, the cup is a left-hand object and the bottle is a right-hand object.
